r.d: Package to validate numbers/checksums/... that have to do with financial data. It currently includes checks for: * IBAN (International Bank Account Number, used for international bankwire transfers) * ISIN (International Securities Identification Number, identification number used for stocks) * identification-numbers found on Euro banknotes
